hook: AI Rumor Says Shumpert's Kids *Aren't* His
dek: Teyana Taylor and Iman Shumpert clapped back at a fake DNA claim with jokes, not drama.

slides.label: What happened
slides.text: A viral IG post claimed DNA tests proved Iman Shumpert isn't the father of his daughters, Junie and Rue Rose.

slides.label: The claim
slides.text: The post used an *AI-generated photo* of Shumpert and unverified claims about his divorce money.

slides.label: Shumpert claps back
slides.text: Shumpert tagged Teyana Taylor on X, joking 'why these not my kids???' and laughed off the fake pic.

slides.label: Taylor joins in
slides.text: Taylor replied the girls look just like their father, turning the rumor into a running joke.

slides.label: Setting the record straight
slides.text: Shumpert confirmed the viral photo was *AI generated* and said he still has a house and a bed.

slides.label: The backstory
slides.text: Taylor filed for divorce in January 2023; their split included public court battles before finalizing in July 2024.

slides.label: Where they stand now
slides.text: Both have spoken about co-parenting Junie and Rue Rose; Shumpert also welcomed daughter Navy with another partner.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.text: AI-made rumors target Black families fast online, showing why media literacy and real receipts matter for all of us.

question: Funnier response: jokes or lawsuit? One word.

Teyana Taylor and Iman Shumpert just shut down a wild paternity rumor about their daughters Junie and Rue Rose, and they did it with jokes instead of lawyers.

A viral Instagram post claimed DNA tests proved Shumpert wasn't the father, using an AI-generated photo to back up the claim. Shumpert clapped back on X, tagging Taylor and joking about the fake image. Taylor joined in, saying the girls look just like their dad.

The former couple's divorce was messy and public before finalizing in July 2024, but this exchange shows they can still laugh together for their kids. Credit to The Grio for the story.

caption_linkedin:
Teyana Taylor and Iman Shumpert just offered a lesson in reputation management for the AI era.

When a viral post used an AI-generated photo to claim Shumpert wasn't the biological father of his daughters, Junie and Rue Rose, the former couple didn't lawyer up. They joked about it publicly, Shumpert on X, Taylor right behind him, and shut the rumor down within hours.

For founders, creators and public figures, especially those in underrepresented communities who are often the first targets of fake content online, the speed and tone of a response matters. Humor, confirmed facts and a united front did more here than a formal statement could have.

Their divorce was public and contentious before finalizing in 2024, which makes this moment even more notable. Credit to The Grio for first reporting the story.

Funnier response: jokes or lawsuit? One word.
